    G = nx.Graph()
    G.add_nodes_from(graph_vertices)
    G.add_edges_from(graph_edges)

    # Convert the graph to a QUBO problem
    qubo_converter = MinimumVertexCoverToQubo()
    qubo_problem = qubo_converter.convert(G)

    # Create a quadratic program from the QUBO problem
    optimizer = SPSA(maxiter=maxiter, seed=seed)
    qp = QuadraticProgram()
    qp.from_qubo(qubo_problem, penalty=penalty)

    # Create a QAOA circuit
    qc = QuantumCircuit(len(graph_vertices))
    qc.h(qc.qubits)
    qc.barrier()
    qc.append(QAOAAnsatz(qc, optimizer, p_layers), qc.qubits)
    qc.barrier()
    qc.measure(qc.qubits, qc.clbits)

    # Define a sampler
    sampler = AerSimulator()
    pass_manager = PassManager(AerSimulator().run(qc, shots=opt_shots).result().get_counts()).compose(AerSimulator().run(qc, shots=final_shots).result().get_counts())

    # Run QAOA
    result = MinimumVertexCover(qubo_problem, optimizer=optimizer, sampler=pass_manager, seed=seed).solve()

    # Get the independent set
    independent_set = set(result['x'])

    # Calculate the independent_set_ratio
    independent_set_ratio = len(independent_set) / optimal_independent_set_size

        "embedding_overhead": embedding_overhead,

    }
